answer: Require each identity to grow a kernel of reputation by completing 20 verified micro-tasks over 30 days before any payout; the fable of free identities ends there, because a second identity starts from zero, repeats all 20 tasks and locks a fresh 40 POA stake for 60 days. Each epoch auditors issue a live echo challenge: every identity must answer a unique prompt within 120 seconds, and a missed or copied echo freezes rewards and slashes 25% of the stake. Each fake needs its own stake, tasks and timely echo, while auditors verify stakes, task records and echo timing on-ledger before release.
